headline: US Prepares Possible Strike on Iran's Mount Al-Mul Nuclear Site
subheadline: A senior American official told Global Eye that the United States may strike Iran's underground nuclear facility at Mount Al-Mul within 24 hours.
lede: The United States may strike Iran's underground nuclear facility at Mount Al-Mul within 24 hours, according to a senior American official cited by Global Eye. In the West Bank, Israeli settlers attacked French, Belgian, and Polish diplomats near Taybeh, damaging a Belgian vehicle and injuring the French mayor, while Israeli forces killed four Hamas operatives in Gaza, including October 7 infiltrator Adham Khalil Muhammad Maarouf. Meanwhile, Russian forces launched large-scale drone and missile strikes across Ukraine, targeting energy infrastructure near the Khmelnytskyi nuclear plant and damaging the Zaporizhzhia steel plant, disrupting power grids nationwide.

sections.title: Russian Strikes Hammer Ukraine's Energy Grid
sections.body: Russian forces launched multiple Shahed drones and Geran-5 missiles at Ukraine's energy infrastructure, including strikes near the Khmelnytskyi nuclear plant. Ballistic missiles struck Zaporizhzhia, damaging residential buildings and the industrial infrastructure of the Zaporizhzhia steel plant, while Ukrainian forces destroyed a drone manufacturing facility in Russia's Rostov region to curb drone supplies. Coordinated attacks hit Chernihiv, Kyiv, Luhansk, Kharkiv and other regions with Shahed-136 drones and Geran-2/3 missiles, and Russian missile strikes hit the Lviv region, raising concerns about potential western Ukraine attacks.

sections.title: US Eyes Iran Strike Amid Regional Violence
sections.body: A senior American official told Global Eye that the United States may strike Iran's underground nuclear facility at Mount Al-Mul within 24 hours. Israeli settlers attacked French, Belgian, and Polish diplomats near Taybeh in the West Bank, damaging a Belgian vehicle and injuring the French mayor, while IDF forces killed four Hamas operatives in Gaza, including October 7 infiltrator Adham Khalil Muhammad Maarouf. Israeli helicopters were seen landing in Syria's As-Suwayda region near the Yarmouk River, an explosion near Sabaa Abkar in Baghdad was heard in the Strait of Hormuz prompting Bushehr naval evacuations, and a mine struck an oil tanker in Hormuz with two tankers targeted by RPG near Saudi Arabia, triggering UKMTO warnings.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Russian forces are escalating drone and missile strikes on Ukraine's energy infrastructure, including near nuclear facilities, which threatens civilian safety and grid stability while attempting to degrade defensive capabilities. The targeting of the Zaporizhzhia steel plant and use of Iskander-M ballistic missiles show a focus on strategic industrial assets and advanced weaponry, continued western attacks raise concerns of potential NATO spillover, and the potential US strike on Iran's Mount Al-Mul facility within 24 hours represents a significant escalation risk in the Middle East.
